scope: source-only continuous-MLS provider; no operator, stiffness assembly, solver, CAD, or fracture evolution

budgets.visibility: continuous MLS; no visibility mask and no source deletion

mls_diagnostics.input_source_order: role manifest sequence; source_id binds every canonical coefficient key

shape_formulas.HEAVISIDE: phi_i*(H(q)-H(X_i)); H exists only for manifest-certified fully split supports; no source deletion
shape_formulas.heaviside_gradient_on_each_open_side: (H(q)-H(X_i))*grad(phi_i); the distributional jump is represented by exact sided rows, not an epsilon offset
shape_formulas.partition_normalization: none; signed MLS weights are not divided by any enriched partition sum
shape_formulas.finite_gamma_traces: PLUS/MINUS evaluated at the exact y=0 coordinate; no epsilon displacement

core_shifted_f1_reproduction.coefficient_choice: BASE_i=c*Fbar(X_i) on T_F; FRONT_i=c; H_i=0; c=A*sqrt(R0)

box_clipped_endpoint_topology_control.scope_note: This checks one endpoint source from the exact pinned case; it does not certify arbitrary clipped finite-crack geometries.

summary.interpretation: whole-box z=0 section sample; collar error is reported data, not an exactness target outside the r<1 mm front core

known_generalization_limit: The provider rejects changed case/classifier/manifest hashes and does not claim the pinned classifier is a proved generic finite-geometry API. Independent review identified tolerance-band holes for arbitrary near-edge support inputs; the frozen manifest margins are far above those bands.
